description: A CarlNotes topic's findings in relevance order, each with Carl's relevance explanation. A connected account's read includes which findings it read and bookmarked. Use it when the user asks Carl or CarlNotes for a topic's findings, with phrases like show this topic, what did Carl find, or read my feed.

cursor.description: The cursor a previous page returned.

topic_id.description: The topic's id. Optional on a topic-bound server, which already knows its topic.

name: read_topic_feed
title: Read a topic's feed
